lines.text: The Natural Gas Sector: Future Outlook
The session will address the tension between domestic demand and exports, between
supply and infrastructure, and between energy security and the promotion of
competition and efficiency. We will examine whether future supply will be sufficient,
what the allocation of resources will look like in the coming years, and whether a
dedicated regulatory framework is required for high-capacity consumers. Participants
